reuse.why: Changes the rule in the existing getScheduledAmount, but keeps that function's inline copy of the 7.5% tolerance instead of switching to the existing getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts.

duplication.why: Adds no new copies; the pre-existing duplicate of the approximate tolerance is left in place in the lines the diff edits.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts in the single planned-amount function every caller uses.

scope.why: Only the helper body, a comment and the matching tests.

maintainability.why: The new rule is simpler (Math.min and subtracting the tolerance) and covered by tests at the helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: the diff routes nothing around the helper; the inline tolerance next to getApproxNumberThreshold pre-dates it
